quotes.text: `Waiting for the correct address book at index ${index} to be selected`
// Let selection of the initial pane complete before selecting another.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Account Hub sync and local-book tests wait until booksList.selectedIndex matches the created directory UID, then check search focus and clean up. Address Book page readiness can precede the requested selection: the tab handler defers its onLoad callback so initial selection completes before the supplied command runs. Current tests use TestUtils.waitForCondition; the owned patch first used BrowserTestUtils. This distinguishes ready from the requested selected state without claiming remote sync, focus or race execution. The expected index is captured once and assumes the row exists.
title: Account Hub tests wait for the requested address book after page readiness
